_meta.notes: Client cosmetic physics and collider budgets. Gameplay collision is analytic on the server; these values size the Rapier layer and its LOD.

gravity_mps2.notes: Downward acceleration for debris and rain on the client.

max_colliders_per_plant.notes: Hard cap on colliders for one plant. Degree-2 runs merge beyond this.

max_collider_plants.notes: How many nearby plants get real colliders at once.

collider_lod_distance_m.notes: Past this distance a plant's segments merge into chains or lose colliders entirely.

chain_merge_min_nodes.notes: Shortest degree-2 run worth merging when the budget is tight.

leaf_collider_mode.notes: Leaf collision: no blade, a thin box, or a convex hull.

joint_colliders.notes: Add a sphere at every segment joint. Off: capsules already cover the tip.

collider_inflation_m.notes: Clearance added to every organ radius so thin tubes still collide.

debris_max_bodies.notes: Dynamic clod/rain bodies allowed on the client at once.

camera_probe_radius_m.notes: Sphere cast radius for camera collision against plant capsules.

collider_rebuild_hz.notes: How often collider data is checked for growth changes.
